title: Banana Pancakes
description: Fluffy pancakes that use one ripe banana.

steps.text: Whisk 1 mashed banana, 1 egg, and 1 cup milk.
Stir in 1 1/4 cups flour, 2 teaspoons baking powder, and 1 tablespoon sugar just until combined.
Heat a lightly buttered skillet over medium heat.
Cook pancakes about 2 minutes on the first side until bubbles form, then flip and cook 1–2 minutes more.

title: Easy Peach Cobbler Cups
description: Warm biscuit-topped peaches baked in a muffin pan or small ramekins.

ingredients.item: sliced peaches, fresh or canned and drained

steps.text: Heat oven to 375°F. Toss 2 cups peaches with 2 tablespoons brown sugar and 1/2 teaspoon cinnamon; divide among 4 ramekins.
Mix 1 cup biscuit mix with 1/3 cup milk to make a soft dough.
Bake 20–25 minutes until topping is golden and fruit bubbles.

title: Pantry Bean & Tomato Pasta
description: Pasta with white beans and tomato sauce for a filling pantry dinner.

steps.text: Cook 12 ounces pasta according to package directions; drain.
Warm 2 cups marinara with 1 can drained white beans and 1/2 teaspoon Italian seasoning for 5 minutes.
Toss pasta with the bean sauce and top with 1/4 cup Parmesan if desired.

title: Corn & Egg Drop Soup
description: A fast brothy soup with ribbons of egg and sweet corn.

steps.text: Bring 4 cups broth and 1 cup corn to a simmer.
Mix 1 tablespoon cornstarch with 2 tablespoons cold water and stir it into the broth; simmer 1 minute.
Beat 3 eggs. Slowly drizzle them into the simmering soup while stirring gently to make ribbons.
Stir in 1 tablespoon soy sauce and serve.
